promise: Help Nemi survive the school job she impulsively accepted after reading free pudding.
want: She wants the promised pudding and an escape from speaking in public.
choice: One companion chooses sensible help or indulgent detours while she rationalizes her own poor judgment.
consequence: Each tempting escape reveals another concrete misunderstanding; the host badge makes the commitment real.
payoff: She manages an imperfect greeting to a toy rehearsal audience, then finally reads that pudding was last Friday.
